sentimento.text1: With 65 days to the [first round](/en/glossary#primeiro-turno), the day's polling is Vox Brasil of Jul 31 (n=2,100, field Jul 26 to 28, 2.15pp margin, 95% confidence, BR-01084/2026): Lula 40.5% x Flávio Bolsonaro 31.2% in the first round, with Ronaldo Caiado 5.5%, Romeu Zema 3.2% and Renan Santos 3.0%. In the [runoff](/en/glossary#segundo-turno), Lula 47.5% x Flávio 41.1%. That is a 9.3pp gap in the first round and 6.4pp in the runoff, and the runoff difference falls OUTSIDE the two margins added together, so this reading does not describe a statistical tie. Adding up the week, three houses measured the first-round gap at 9.1pp, 6pp and 9.3pp, which makes PoderData of Jul 30 the outlier, not Vox.
sentimento.text2: The day's crossing has a clear asymmetry: Lula did not move and the rest of the board moved a lot. His winner contract stayed at 63.50% for a second consecutive session, while Flávio rose 0.35pp, Renan Santos fell 0.30pp, Caiado fell 0.80pp, Camilo Santana rose 1.70pp and Alckmin rose 0.75pp. THREE consecutive institutes cut Renan Santos, and it is the sequence that matters, not the isolated number: AtlasIntel 7.8% on Jul 29, PoderData 4% on Jul 30 and Vox Brasil 3.0% on Jul 31. With the price at 8.15%, the distance between market and polling reaches 5.15pp, the widest in the window. On Jul 29 the panel recorded that same distance at 0.90pp and called it convergence. Three institutes later, it has quadrupled.
sentimento.text3: In the market, Lula was FLAT at 63.50% (vol USD 7.77M) for a second day. Flávio rose 0.35pp, to 24.30% (vol USD 7.76M), and the gap narrowed from +39.55pp to +39.20pp, by his movement and not the front-runner's. Renan Santos fell 0.30pp, to 8.15% (vol USD 8.63M). Caiado fell 0.80pp, to 1.75% (vol USD 5.22M), giving back in one session the gain of two days. Camilo Santana rose to 2.20% (vol USD 4.16M) and Geraldo Alckmin to 1.10% (vol USD 4.98M). Jair Bolsonaro stayed at 0.95%, Tereza Cristina at 0.55%, Zema fell 0.10pp to 0.45% and Haddad rose 0.15pp to 0.30%. Tarcísio de Freitas remains at 0.15% (vol USD 13.68M), still the highest accumulated volume in the book. Total accumulated volume in the presidential market adds up to USD 117.03M.
sentimento.direita: Flávio rose 0.35pp, to 24.30% (vol USD 7.76M), and narrowed the gap to +39.20pp. In the sub-markets the signal is crossed and worth recording: he FELL 1.00pp in the [first-round](/en/glossary#primeiro-turno) second-place book, to 78.00% (vol USD 216,000), and FELL 0.60pp in the third-place book, to 5.65%. Rising in the chance of winning while giving ground in both placing books is an unusual combination, and the counterpart to the fall in the second-place book is Renan Santos rising 3.25pp in that same contract, which suggests internal reallocation rather than a fresh reading on the [runoff](/en/glossary#segundo-turno). In the polling, Vox has him at 31.2% in the first round and 41.1% in the runoff, with the 6.4pp difference falling outside the two margins added together. The day was busy on ticket-building: he said Tereza Cristina had accepted the running-mate slot, the senator said there had been a conversation and that the decision depends on the PL and the PP-União, and the PP leadership assesses that she accepted knowing the party would block it. Three versions of the same fact, and the panel records all three. The Aug 5 deadline for naming a running mate is less than a week away.
sentimento.esquerda: Lula was FLAT at 63.50% (vol USD 7.77M) for a second consecutive session, holding the value that ties the top of the AFOS series. The gap narrowed to +39.20pp by his opponent's movement. At Vox Brasil he has 40.5% in the [first round](/en/glossary#primeiro-turno) and 47.5% in the [runoff](/en/glossary#segundo-turno), with a 6.4pp lead that falls outside the two margins added together. The institute records that, between May and July, Lula gained 7.3pp and Flávio lost 2.7pp within its own series, reversing a lead that had belonged to the senator, and the panel reproduces that as the institute's claim, because it is an internal comparison of theirs. Two names from his camp rose in the market on the same day: Camilo Santana to 2.20% and Geraldo Alckmin to 1.10%, on the day the PCdoB formalized support for the Lula-Alckmin ticket. The panel records the coincidence and does not assert cause. On Camilo, the series caveat is mandatory: 2.20% is NOT a peak, his series maximum is 4.10%, from May 3, and what happened was a recovery from the series MINIMUM, 0.50%, set the day before.
sentimento.terceiraVia: The chasing pack had its busiest day of the week. CAIADO gave it all back: he fell 0.80pp, to 1.75% (vol USD 5.22M), undoing in one session the gain of two days. The series caveat undoes any reading of collapse, because 1.75% sits inside his normal range since Jul 22 and the 2.55% of the previous day was the deviation. And he RISES 1.00pp in the [first-round](/en/glossary#primeiro-turno) third-place book, to 26.50%, which makes the signal crossed. In the polling, Vox gives him 5.5%, his best national reading in the window, above PoderData's 5% and well above AtlasIntel's 3.1%. The divergence about him remains open at four levels within the same month. RENAN SANTOS fell 0.30pp in the winner book, to 8.15% (vol USD 8.63M), but ROSE 3.25pp in the first-round second-place book, to 9.35%, recovering two thirds of what he had lost the previous day. That is the contradiction of the day: the polling cuts him for a third consecutive institute and the money hands back part of the runoff chance it had removed 24 hours earlier. CAMILO SANTANA rose to 2.20% and ALCKMIN to 1.10%, both on the day of the PCdoB's formal support for the Lula-Alckmin ticket. ZEMA fell 0.10pp, to 0.45%, in a third consecutive session of decline, on a day when Marcelo Aro left his Senate ticket to run for the government of Minas Gerais, a move Zema publicly called betrayal.
sentimento.polymarket: Lula 63.50% (flat, vol USD 7.77M), Flávio 24.30% (up 0.35pp, vol USD 7.76M), Renan Santos 8.15% (down 0.30pp, vol USD 8.63M), Camilo Santana 2.20% (vol USD 4.16M), Caiado 1.75% (down 0.80pp, vol USD 5.22M), Alckmin 1.10% (vol USD 4.98M), Jair 0.95%, Tereza Cristina 0.55%, Zema 0.45% (down 0.10pp), Haddad 0.30% (up 0.15pp). Lula's gap over Flávio at +39.20pp, against +39.55pp on Jul 30. Total accumulated volume in the presidential market at USD 117.03M. Sub-markets: [first-round](/en/glossary#primeiro-turno) second place with Flávio 78.00% (down 1.00pp, vol USD 216,000), Renan Santos 9.35% (UP 3.25pp, vol USD 1.09M) and Lula 8.25%; third place with Renan 62.00% (flat, vol USD 164,000), Caiado 26.50% (up 1.00pp, vol USD 37,000), Flávio 5.65% (down 0.60pp) and Zema 4.45%; impeachment of an [STF](/en/glossary#stf) justice FLAT at 3.10% (vol USD 83,000); Senate with PL 72.00% (up 6.50pp, vol USD 258,000) and MDB as a declared RANGE of 25.20% to 26.60%; inflation with the 5.00% to 5.49% band at 38.30% and the 4.50% to 4.99% band at 33.70% (up 1.20pp). The double-reading capture guard failed BOTH of today's rounds, which is why the range rule applies. What repeated goes in FIRM and what diverged goes in as a declared RANGE. One book diverged, the MDB in the Senate, which swung between 25.20% and 26.60% across three readings. The full presidential contract repeated across ALL FOUR readings, so the panel's headline figure is firm. Live capture Jul 31, 20:33 UTC.

inss.text1: The fiscal agenda saw no fresh development, with the Senate in recess and the Budget as the next front of friction between the Senate presidency and the government. The political day was about ticket-building, not economics: Flávio Bolsonaro said Tereza Cristina had accepted the running-mate slot, the senator said there had been a conversation and that the decision depends on the PL and the PP-União, and the PP leadership assesses that she accepted knowing the party would block it. In Minas Gerais, Marcelo Aro left Romeu Zema's Senate ticket to run for the state government, and Zema called the move betrayal. The PCdoB formalized support for the Lula-Alckmin ticket.
inss.text2: The market's mark for the day was asymmetry: the front-runner did not move and almost everything else did. Lula stayed at 63.50% for a second session, while Flávio rose 0.35pp, Renan fell 0.30pp, Caiado fell 0.80pp and two names from the government's camp rose. THREE consecutive institutes cut Renan Santos, and it is the sequence that matters, not the isolated number: AtlasIntel 7.8% on Jul 29, PoderData 4% on Jul 30 and Vox Brasil 3.0% on Jul 31. With the price at 8.15%, the distance between market and polling reaches 5.15pp, the widest in the window. On Jul 29 the panel recorded that same distance at 0.90pp and called it convergence. Three institutes later, it has quadrupled.
inss.text3: The market on impeachment of an [STF](/en/glossary#stf) justice was FLAT at 3.10% (vol USD 83,000), with no variation across the four readings of today's capture guard. A day with no fresh institutional development on that axis, and the price followed the absence. With USD 83,000 in accumulated volume against USD 117.03M in the presidential market, this contract is only worth recording when it moves in a sustained way, and today it simply did not move.
inss.text4: In the Senate, the PL ROSE 6.50pp and reached 72.00% (vol USD 258,000), and the MDB enters today as a declared RANGE, from 25.20% to 26.60%, because it was the only book the capture guard failed on both rounds. Added together, the two carry more than 97% of the probability assigned to just two parties, which by itself indicates a wide spread in that book. In inflation, the modal band is still 5.00% to 5.49%, at 38.30%, and the 4.50% to 4.99% band rose 1.20pp, to 33.70%, in a book of USD 81,000 that is NOT covered by the guard. A large move in a small book is a record, not a signal.
inss.impactoLula: Vox Brasil of Jul 31 did not publish approval and disapproval in this round, so the evaluation picture remains the one from Jul 30, with the week's two opposite readings still standing: PoderData measured personal approval falling to 43% against 49% disapproval, and AtlasIntel, 24 hours earlier, measured it rising 1.7pp, to 47.6% against 51.2%. The panel continues to show AtlasIntel on the gauge, by the criterion it published on Jul 29, the largest sample and the smallest margin in the window. The week's band remains between 43% and 49%.
inss.impactoGestao: The Vox Brasil round of Jul 31 did NOT publish a management rating, so the picture remains the one from Jul 30 and the week's two readings still stand, pointing in opposite directions. PoderData of Jul 30 brought 34% good or very good, 16% fair and 47% poor or terrible, with poor or terrible rising 10pp against the institute's Jul 22 round. AtlasIntel of Jul 29 measured 49.3% poor or terrible, BTG/Nexus of Jul 27 measured 43% and Datafolha of Jul 24 measured 38%. The four institutes still agree on what matters most: management is rated worse than the person, and the distance between the two indicators persists.
inss.conclusao: With 65 days to the election, the day was one of asymmetry: the front-runner's price sat still at 63.50% for a second session and almost everything else on the board moved. The new polling, Vox Brasil of Jul 31 (n=2,100, field Jul 26 to 28, 2.15pp margin, 95% confidence, BR-01084/2026), gives 40.5% x 31.2% in the [first round](/en/glossary#primeiro-turno) and 47.5% x 41.1% in the [runoff](/en/glossary#segundo-turno), and that 6.4pp difference falls outside the two margins added together, unlike what PoderData measured the day before. Three houses in the same week gave 9.1pp, 6pp and 9.3pp for the first-round gap, and the panel records that the outlier is PoderData. THREE consecutive institutes cut Renan Santos, and it is the sequence that matters, not the isolated number: AtlasIntel 7.8% on Jul 29, PoderData 4% on Jul 30 and Vox Brasil 3.0% on Jul 31. With the price at 8.15%, the distance between market and polling reaches 5.15pp, the widest in the window. On Jul 29 the panel recorded that same distance at 0.90pp and called it convergence. Three institutes later, it has quadrupled. And the market contradicted itself in his case, handing back in the second-place book part of what it had taken 24 hours earlier. CAIADO gave back the whole two-day gain on the same day he received the best national polling of the window. None of these readings is attributed to a cause, because the day had no event that explains them.

bancoMaster.text1: Friday brought no fresh act in the Master case, and the record is one of continuity with a locked verb. The Federal Police's consideration of asking Interpol to include Flávio Bolsonaro and Daniel Vorcaro in the silver notice, recorded on Jul 30, stands exactly as it was: the Federal Police is CONSIDERING, it has not filed, and Interpol has decided nothing. A silver notice locates assets and funds abroad and is NOT an arrest order, unlike a red notice. The stated target is to trace the R$ 61 million from Banco Master said to have financed the film about Jair Bolsonaro's career.
bancoMaster.text2: On the legislative front, the news is still the absence of a decision. The writ of mandamus disputing the installation of the Banco Master CPI has sat for more than four months in Kassio Nunes Marques's chambers, and the request by four senators to remove him from the case was rejected. With the Senate in recess and the August agenda still contested, there is no deadline in sight. The panel records the elapsed time because it is the fact: four months without a decision on installing a CPI is, in itself, a decision about installing it.
bancoMaster.text3: On price, the record is one of stillness and it is worth a single line: the market on impeachment of an [STF](/en/glossary#stf) justice was FLAT at 3.10%, in a book of USD 83,000, with no variation across any of the four readings of today's capture guard. On a day with no fresh institutional development, a still price is the expected behaviour. The panel does not build a reading on the absence of movement in a contract that size.
bancoMaster.conclusao: The three fronts of the Master case remain on separate tracks and should not be added together: the criminal one, at the [STF](/en/glossary#stf) under André Mendonça, with overseas asset tracing authorized in a May decision and the Interpol question still under CONSIDERATION; the asset one, in the Rio courts, with freezes; and the legislative one, stalled for more than four months in Nunes Marques's chambers. None of them produced a new act on Friday. The only market touching the case, impeachment of an STF justice, sat still at 3.10%, in a book of USD 83,000 that cannot support a reading of risk repricing in any direction.

stf.toffoli: Toffoli remains isolated at the [STF](/en/glossary#stf) after the Master crisis, with no fresh individual act captured on Friday.
stf.moraes: No new order from Moraes captured on Friday. The front he opened over the artificial-intelligence video shown at the PL convention remains live, with the 48-hour deadline already expired and the next decision pending.
stf.gilmar: No individual act from Gilmar in the period. The recent joint vote stands, with Dino, Moraes and Zanin, which reduced restrictions on penduricalhos.
stf.dino: No new act on Friday. Still running is the 10-day deadline set on Jul 29 for the government and Congress to specify the responsibility of members of Congress over earmarks.
stf.mendonca: He remains rapporteur of the inquiry opened on Jul 23 into Vorcaro's transfers for the film about Jair Bolsonaro. No new act on Friday. The Federal Police's consideration of asking Interpol to include Flávio Bolsonaro and Daniel Vorcaro in the silver notice, recorded on Jul 30, remains a CONSIDERATION: the Federal Police has not filed and Interpol has decided nothing.
stf.nexo: Friday's connecting thread moved off the judicial axis and onto the party axis, and it is about ticket composition. Flávio Bolsonaro said Tereza Cristina had accepted the running-mate slot on his ticket; the senator said there had been a conversation and that the decision depends on the PL and the PP-União; and the PP leadership assesses that she accepted precisely because she knew the party would block it. Three versions of the same fact, and the panel records all three without choosing. On the other side, the PCdoB formalized support for the Lula-Alckmin ticket, and in Minas Gerais Marcelo Aro left Zema's Senate ticket to run for the state government, a move Zema called betrayal. The Aug 5 deadline for naming running mates is less than a week away and is what organizes the coming days.
stf.analise: The market on impeachment of an [STF](/en/glossary#stf) justice before 2027 was FLAT at 3.10% (vol USD 83,000), with no variation in any of the four readings of today's capture guard. It is the second consecutive session at the same value. The reading is short and it is this: a day with no fresh institutional development on that axis, and a still price. In a book of USD 83,000 against USD 117.03M in the presidential market, absence of movement in the face of absence of fact is the expected behaviour, and recording it costs one sentence.
